legal_entity: Xapo Bank Limited (Gibraltar, company no. 111928) — operator named in the page footer; no separate programme entity
application_conditions: No application: every member obtains a unique referral link or code in the app (xapo.com/app/referrals). The page does not describe a publisher or affiliate programme and states no channel rules.
paid_action: Referred person signs up with the link/code, completes onboarding and activates membership by paying the annual membership fee (US$1,000 at the time of reading).
validation_conditions: Both accounts active and in good standing; the referee must remain a member past a 33-day validation period. The former US$5,000 minimum-balance requirement is stated as removed.

commission.model_note: One-time reward of US$500 paid in BTC to the referrer, and US$500 in BTC to the referee ('you both receive a $500 USD in BTC reward'). The membership-benefits page footnotes mention a UK variant paid in USD. 'Refer as many friends as you'd like, with no cap.'

payout.method: BTC credited to the Xapo Bank Bitcoin wallet (UK variant: USD)
payout.frequency: After the referee's account is opened and the 33-day validation period ends

rules_note: Personal referral programme that requires the referrer to be a Xapo Bank member (US$1,000/year). No publisher/affiliate programme found on xapobank.com this run. No dedicated referral terms linked — only the general Website Terms of Use.
allowed_countries_note: Follows Xapo Bank membership eligibility: not residents of the 28 prohibited countries (incl. the United States); UK referrals paid in USD per the membership page footnote.

evidence.title: Xapo Bank — Referral programme page
evidence.excerpt: 'you both receive a $500 USD in BTC reward'; referee signs up with the referrer's link or code, completes onboarding and activates membership by paying the annual fee; both accounts active and in good standing; reward after a 33-day validation period; 'Refer as many friends as you'd like, with no cap'; codes at xapo.com/app/referrals.

notes: Identified only. Nobody contacted, no account opened. Using this programme would require the site operator to hold a paid Xapo Bank membership — a cost and an independence question for David before any use.
